9. First start

Short attempts, with a log review after each one.

Ctrl K

You will need

  • Fire extinguisher
  • A helper
  • Log recording

Start → Now → Start state

Steps

  1. Put everything backPlugs, coils, injectors, pump relays. Release the fuel-off button.
  2. Start recordingRpm, sync, pressure, battery, coolant.
  3. Starter up to 5 sWatch: pressure builds, injections run, rpm rises.
  4. Did not startStop and review the log. If the plugs are flooded: flood clear, lever fully open while cranking.
  5. StartedDo not rev. Check oil pressure, leaks and temperatures at once. Shut down after 30–60 s and review the log.

Done when

  • Engine holds rpm
  • Oil pressure present
  • No leaks

Stop if

  • No oil pressure: shut down immediately
  • Fuel leak
  • Backfire
